description: This file contains functions related to upgrading and flashing firmware for Zyxel devices. It includes procedures for determining root filesystem, flashing kernel and root filesystem, and performing upgrades with device-specific logic.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Reads the kernel command line from /proc/cmdline to extract the root filesystem device.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Handles the flashing process for kernel and root filesystem, including creating loop devices, formatting, and copying data.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade logic, determining device partitions and invoking flash procedures.
